Legacy desktop stat opacity fix is verified, pointer interception protections hold, and back-to-circuit overview preservation works. Strict exact-stop acceptance remains failing due non-deterministic route settle positions, especially on mobile.

action_items: Remove timing-based settle drift in marker navigation so active-state lock only clears after scroll position is exactly target top for each route stop.
Ensure mobile marker navigation reaches strict stop numerators (timeline=3660, legacy=2880, cars=4440 with denominator=12000) before data-traveling flips to false.
Re-run strict acceptance batches after settle logic fix: timeline desktop 5/5 exact 0.305 and mobile 5/5 exact 0.305.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: Legacy active stats now compute opacity='1' with transform reset and animationName='none' on desktop and mobile; previous hidden-stat regression is fixed.
Good: marker-hit receives elementFromPoint at timeline marker center, indicating decorative marker layers are not intercepting pointer events.

High-risk: navigation settle currently uses fixed timeout fallback (~1850ms), which can clear lock before reaching exact target position on some runs/devices, causing stop drift despite correct activeKey.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified passing: no .error elements before/after flows, no horizontal overflow, back-to-circuit preserves overview (data-overview='true'), timeline marker Enter/Space activation works functionally, and legacy six stats are visible with opacity 1. Outstanding blocker is strict exact-stop determinism: desktop timeline 4/5 exact, mobile timeline 0/5 exact, plus mobile legacy/cars exact-stop misses.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: from circuit overview, activate markers (pointer/keyboard) and wait until data-traveling='false'. Observe active chapter is correct but scroll numerator often misses exact target (especially on mobile). Root cause hypothesis from code path in SpatialExperience: navigation lock can be released by fixed settle timeout fallback before the smooth Lenis travel fully converges to the computed top, then activeKey is forced to chapter regardless of exact scroll position. Mitigation: gate settle completion on numeric convergence to target top (or force immediate snap at settle) instead of pure timer fallback.
